column1: Details of Mr E and Mr F

column2: Mr E and Mr F are both SCs

Mr E was not working between July 2023 and March 2024. He has been working since April 2024, with an average gross monthly income of $2,000. Mr F worked in July 2023 to February 2024 with an average gross monthly income of $1,800. He has ceased working since March 2024. Both applicants did not work continuously during the 12-month period ending 2 months before their HFE letter application.
Not considered for EHG assessment as none of the applicants met the 12-month continuous employment condition.
Mr E and Mr F will each receive a Singles Grant of $40,000.
